text:
Priya K: Quick q — embeddings endpoint semantics for mixed-dim payloads. Customer sent a single POST with vectors of 128 and 512 dims mixed together and we had weird routing + some 413s. How should the splitter/router behave and how do we count quota for those requests?

Jamal R: Short answer: split into per-dimension-compatible subrequests. We can still batch within each dim. Quota: product currently expects billing per input embedding generated, not bytes, so count inputs. But we need to confirm edge cases (client expects per-request quota). 413s are probably the gateway/body-size limit, not our model.

Alex M: Agree with Jamal. A few practical things:
- Router: detect unique dims in body, create N subrequests (one per dim) and route to matching model endpoints.
- Telemetry: emit "embed_dims_set", "embed_subrequest_count", "orig_batch_size", "sub_batch_sizes", "request_bytes" and router decision tag.
- Add header `X-Embed-Split: v2` so logs show it.

Sara L: Note model compatibility: some model variants accept only fixed dims (eg. 512). We should fail-fast if client requests a model that can't handle a dim, rather than silently converting. For cost: quantized variants change output byte-size but we still bill per-vector. Also watch KV cache overhead if we break big batches into many tiny ones.

Priya K: Re billing: product wants clarity for customers — if a user sends 10 inputs in one HTTP call and we split into 2 subrequests (6 + 4) we should show 10 inputs billed and in console show the split as internal detail. Confirming that is the UX ask.

Marta (console): UX requests:
- Dashboard should show "split events" (count) and a small histogram of dims seen by route.
- Add drilldown for a single request showing original payload size, subrequests created, and bytes per subrequest.
- Suggested UX: if we detect repeated mixed-dim clients, show a proactive tip: "Consider normalizing to single-dim embeddings to reduce splits."

Alex M: Implementation notes/code sketch:
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-512",
  "input": [[0.1,0.2,...], [0.2,0.3,...], /* one 128 dim vector */ ]
}
```
Router should inspect `input` array -> build grouped payloads and call internal `/internal/embed-batch` endpoints. Preflight check: if total_request_bytes > GATEWAY_LIMIT -> return 413 with helpful body { "error":"payload_too_large", "suggested_max_inputs": 1024 }.

Jamal R: 413 flow: instead of opaque nginx error, do a preflight that estimates encoded body size (incoming compressed vs raw differences are tricky) — simplest: set a conservative threshold and return our structured 413 + `x-embed-suggested-split` header. That will reduce noisy infra alerts.

Alex M: Telemetry event example we should emit for each root request (flattened fields so logging/querying is easy):
```
event: embed_request_handled
fields:
  orig_input_count: 18
  orig_bytes: 142000
  dims_seen: [128,512]
  subrequest_counts: [12,6]
  router_policy: "prefer-compat"
  split_flag: "embed-splitter-v2-true"
```
(we'll convert to real metric names when adding to schema)

Priya K: Rollout plan suggestion: feature flag `embed-splitter-v2`. Canary 10% for 48h, check these signals: 413 rate, 5xx, p90 latency per route, cost delta per-tenant. If green -> 25% for a day -> 100%. Add an automatic rollback if p50 latency regresses >20% or 5xx spike > 0.5% absolute.

Marta (console): For canary visibility: add a quicktime dashboard for the flag showing canary cohort metrics side-by-side with control: latency, error-rate, cost-per-1k. Also surface top offending clients (by tenant id) for follow-up.

Sara L: One more model note: when splitting, preserve order of inputs in the combined response so clients don't get confused. Also include `split_map` in response metadata so clients can reconcile if they want to.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary flag `embed-splitter-v2` created in staging at 2026-03-16T16:02Z.

Jamal R: Action items: I will add preflight size check + suggest-split header (PR by EOD). Alex: add telemetry fields and header. Marta: add dashboard placeholders. Priya: update billing & docs to state per-input billing and show split as internal-only. Sara: add ordering + split_map contract to API spec.

Priya K: Thanks team — please drop PR links here when ready and I'll coordinate the canary. :thumbsup:
